name: Moldova 1
notes: TRM public TV. Airs digitised Moldova-Film titles. TRM's own grid is published unevenly — 56 slots one day, 6 the next — so altSchedule pulls TV Mail's Chișinău listing for the same channel and merges what TRM missed. That source embeds schema.org JSON-LD with absolute timestamps, so its slots carry a real date instead of an assumed weekday.

name: Moldova 2
notes: Heaviest archive/culture rotation. A confirmed past airing of Tunul de lemn was announced here (Sâmbătă, ora 12:00, 'Moldova 2 cultural').

name: TRM — știri cultură
notes: Not a grid. Scanned for headlines AND for explicit broadcast announcements, which name a channel and exact time — these land before the grid updates.

name: TRM — toate știrile
notes: Wider net than the culture section — restored-film premieres occasionally get filed under general news.

name: TVR Moldova
notes: Verified 26 Jul 2026: TVR Moldova publishes NO schedule grid — /program-tv, /program, /grila-de-programe and /live all return 404, and the site exposes only per-show pages. So it is scanned as an announcements source (headlines + explicit broadcast announcements) rather than a grid. live is null so the stream resolver skips it instead of failing every run.

name: Vocea Basarabiei TV
notes: Schedule table is JavaScript-loaded and was empty when checked (25 Jul 2026). Kept on at zero cost, flagged expectEmpty so it never cries wolf.

name: Diez — cultură
notes: Moldovan press. Republishes Moldova-Film broadcast and screening announcements — a fetchable substitute for the Facebook page, which blocks automation.

name: Moldpres — cultură
notes: State news agency. Carries official Moldova-Film and Ministry of Culture announcements.

name: TV Moldova Internațional
notes: Disabled — largely mirrors Moldova 1. Enable if you want the extra coverage.
